frozen_physical_control_sources.preflight_note: Actual module is authenticated to the common frozen harness; candidate is not claimed as b4.

actuator_response_evidence.scope: Wheel-output effective inertia and moving resistance only; four leg axes remain the nominal prior.

uncovered_fields: PhysX contact/solver/warm-start internal state; exact state restoration unsupported
standalone script_requested and script_capped torque locals are not exported by native torque()
raw legs/wheels before signal-delay are not re-decoded; actual motor_efforts inputs are captured
training physical signal-delay condition is excluded by the frozen full role
state-write interception covers the four native reset APIs, not arbitrary external PhysX view writes
